text.name: Warehouse
text.tagline: Control inventory and track goods movement across the organization
text.description: The Cyber ERP Warehouse module manages inventory movement across the organization's warehouses with shared item coding, receipt and issue recording, and tracking factors such as serial numbers and projects. Viewing on-hand, in-transit, blocked, and consignment stock, defining multiple units of measure, and setting stock limits and reorder points help control supply and consumption. Integration with purchasing, sales, production, quality control, and finance keeps item documents and data consistent across related processes.
benefits: View inventory by warehouse and stock status
Track receipts and issues by serial number and defined factors
Use unified item coding across the organization
Control stock limits and reorder points
Align receipts and issues with purchasing, sales, and production

text.name: Quantitative Inventory
text.cardText: Manage goods receipts, issues, and transfers with warehouse, unit of measure, and tracking details.
text.tagline: Record and track goods receipts and issues
text.description: The Quantitative Inventory system links item and warehouse data with receipt, issue, transfer, and tool handover documents. Recording serial numbers and tracking factors, packaging, and units of measure makes it possible to track goods movement. Referencing documents to purchasing, sales, and production keeps inventory aligned with the organization's operations.
benefits: Record receipts and issues against source documents
Support units of measure and packaging
Track tool handovers and stock transfers

text.name: Inventory Control
text.cardText: View stock status, control stock limits, and identify items that have reached their reorder point.
text.description: The Inventory Control system makes stock available by warehouse and by on-hand, in-transit, blocked, and consignment status. Setting minimum and maximum stock levels and reorder points, and viewing items outside these limits, helps with supply planning. Integration with production and purchasing requirements makes it easier to follow up on shortages.
benefits: Track items that have reached their reorder point

text.name: Inventory Accounting
text.cardText: Set item costing methods, link warehouse movements to accounting, and report inventory value.
text.tagline: Inventory valuation linked to financial data
text.description: The Inventory Accounting system relies on goods movement data and the costing method defined for each item. It supports methods such as weighted average, first-in first-out (FIFO), and specific identification for item costing. Linking the warehouse with finance supports the use of inventory data in reviewing costs and item value.
benefits: A consistent basis for inventory valuation
Help track item costs and value
